task: 사용자가 선호하고 전신 제작에 지정한 v17 두 얼굴로 전신 확장 v18
method: One face identity per independent generation; no rejected paired-body face input. Three initial full-body calls, followed by two mage costume-only correction edits.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / extend portrait to full-body game character.
Take the SINGLE ADULT WOMAN in the attached head portrait and extend her into one finished HEAD-TO-TOE dark-fantasy character illustration. The portrait is the authoritative facial identity and rendering reference. Preserve the same recognizable person, not a new prettified face. Match actual eye spacing and eyelid contours, nose length/bridge/tip, mouth shape and upper/lower lip proportions, cheek breadth, jaw and chin, skin tone and age. Retain fine realistic painterly skin texture and subtle human asymmetry. No generic doll face, oversized eyes, tiny button nose, universal V-chin or glossy beauty filter.
One character ONLY. Mature woman in her twenties, compact naturally athletic adult build, about 7 heads tall, believable moderate leg length, not a towering fashion model. Front-facing face and torso, head upright directly over neck, eyes horizontal, chin neutral, shoulders relaxed and level, quiet attentive neutral expression with naturally closed lips. No head tilt, selfie angle, side-eye, pouting, 3/4 face or leaning S-curve stance. Comfortable shoulder-width planted feet, knees soft, balanced weight, arms naturally relaxed and slightly separated from torso so hands and clothing are readable. Practical flat boots, no stilettos.
Keep the portrait's calm realistic HAND-PAINTED rendering, subtle textured shadows, restrained low-saturation dark-fantasy palette, worn leather and dark metal with controlled highlights. Do not revert to shiny anime/game CGI. Warm-gray painterly studio backdrop and subtle contact shadow, simple diffuse front light consistent with the face. A VERTICAL 2:3 full-body image, from full hair crown down to both boot soles with generous clear margin above and below, fingers also entirely inside frame. Figure fills about 85% image height. No inset portrait, no caption, label, logo or watermark. No held prop. Facial likeness is the highest priority. Keep this Woni-reference heroine's same half-up black-brown long hair and individual face including the small cheek mole. Her costume is the BARE-ABS heroine's established role: fitted dark navy-black HIGH-NECK CROPPED leather protective bodice fully covers breasts/chest, stops above the waist and leaves naturally toned BARE ABDOMEN AND WAIST visible; understated believable athletic abs, not exaggerated bodybuilding. Full-length fitted charcoal leather trousers cover BOTH thighs completely, dark practical flat armored boots. Short asymmetric navy shoulder mantle with worn edges but strong coherent large cloth shapes, no long trailing cape or repeated tiny torn strips. Quiet worn dark-steel shoulder/knee guards, restrained buckles, no dense gold filigree. Her LEFT forearm (VIEWER'S RIGHT) carries a distinctive somewhat oversized sculptural dark-metal gauntlet with EXACTLY ONE embedded blue core and subtle blue seams, well-defined rigid finger guards. The other forearm has simple wraps and glove. Arms do not hide the abdomen. This full-body costume specification replaces the incidental collar/shoulder costume in the portrait; preserve the FACE from the portrait exactly. No bare thigh, no short skirt, no second luminous core.
